notes: Side view, facing east (No.10 is right-footed: near/right leg kicks, far/left leg plants). GALE never mirrors, so there is no west strip. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). Ground frames sit on contact = the planted boot's toe-tip column on row 102 (constant while the foot is planted; the toe outline is 1 px further right); airborne frames (contact null) sit on pelvis. ball = the 12 px ball guide centre at rest (never drawn in the frame); boot = instep point; head = skull point; eye = the side eye; bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Layers in the studio: Art only (no Num/Ball layer; numbers are in Art). AP1 = Run R4 registration with the head turned away (pass T1). AP2 = the bound, airborne on pelvis (60,66); GALE 2 moves it along path = [[t, worldPelvisX, worldPelvisY], ...] in Run-canvas px at x1 (sprite origin = path point - pelvis), 0.30-0.55. AP3 = AP2 with the head away (pass T2).
